title: I built a water gate that lets me control a river in my voxel colony game
author: Arrock12
selftext:
I’ve been working on water gates in StoneEra. Opening one lets water flow through; closing it holds the water back, so you can control where it goes and build around it.  
This clip shows the system in Creative Mode. In the normal game, villagers will handle the construction.  
If you’d like to follow development, you can wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/

comments.author: SeasawPhilosopher
comments.body: Very cool. I was a big fan of Timberborne and love colony sim + physics + real engineering.

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body:
I've been a fan of Timberborn too! I've been playing it since some of the really early versions.

I really like games that go deep into one specific gameplay aspect instead of keeping everything simple. In StoneEra, I'm currently focusing a lot on expanding the water mechanics, and I'm really enjoying where it's going.

replies.author: SeasawPhilosopher
replies.body: That’s great, I wish Timerborne had more interesting water mechanics and less clunky building of many things. For example mega projects like giant aqueducts took forever to complete.  Going deep in simple mechanics is the way to go, that’s the focus in my games too.

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body: I'm also planning to add water boiling and eventually make steam usable for different mechanisms, like lifts and other machinery.

replies.author: SeasawPhilosopher
replies.body: Okay that would be super cool. Any inspiration from oxygen not included?

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body: I actually haven't played Oxygen Not Included that much, so I haven't really had the chance to explore all of its mechanics.

comments.author: Easy-Coconut-33
comments.body: Looks great! Love voxel based games.
